facts.text: Audrey expresses a strong bond with her dogs and values their happiness.

evidence.quote: Yeah, my dogs make me really happy. I love them so much and I want to make them as happy as possible. We have a strong bond.
That's amazing. You have such a strong bond with them! I hope I can have such a strong bond with Toby as well.
They mean the world to me. I'm so lucky to have them.

facts.text: Andrew acknowledges the rewarding nature of caring for pets and expresses hope for a strong bond with Toby.

evidence.quote: I'm sure it's rewarding. Making a positive impact on someone's life, especially those close to you, must be such a good feeling.
That's amazing. You have such a strong bond with them! I hope I can have such a strong bond with Toby as well.
Lucky you! Pets sure bring a lot of love and joy. Can't wait till Toby and I bond better.
